title: crepis vesicaria subsp. andryaloides
intro: Crepis vesicaria subsp. andryaloides, commonly known as Hawkbit, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the potential health benefits of reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Crepis vesicaria subsp. andryaloides include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
